# Deploying workbooks

<!-- GENERATED by `work weave` from skills/deploying_workbooks.work — do not edit; edit the source docs it composes. -->

A woven workbook is shipped by running it on a **nexus** — locally for parity, or in
the cloud. The `work` CLI's deploy verbs (`deploy init / validate / apply`) take the
woven tree to a running endpoint. This skill covers the path from a local run to a
cloud deployment.

When the user wants to ship, host, or run a workbook for others, load the references
below.
